summary: legal checked in 3 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch and rights-dependent monetization; conditional for ordinary reversible internal work. Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private_only, do not send external permission outreach, expand alerts, enable monetization, deploy, or change tracking. Evidence: Woot public terms do not establish commercial/public redistribution rights; 0 of 4 legal launch tasks are closed; accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and security gates are blocked; compliance is technical-only with 34 pass, 14 fail, and 11 unknown; analytics and revenue attribution remain partially incomplete. Progress: 0/4 tasks closed and no task is closable on current evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/caching/display/derivatives/alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. This is risk triage, not legal advice or certification; human counsel is required for upstream rights, privacy/jurisdiction, and any affiliate or advertising use.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required because written permission and field-level rights for storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademarks, images, prices, affiliate use, and advertising are missing. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed because inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are not evidenced. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed because deployed consent/withdrawal behavior, property and data-sharing settings, retention, and jurisdictional treatment are not evidenced. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed because log fields, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA coverage, incident handling, and data-request procedures are not evidenced. Smallest next actions: complete the rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review; produce the repository/deployed data-flow and retention table; capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising; produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory.

Fleet triage: ordinary reversible growth is conditional, not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry, provided it preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Do not treat aggregate affiliate earnings as site-attributable: the recorded $4.92 commission is provider-aggregate and revenue, ROI, margin, payback, and causal lift remain unknown. Compliance failures and unknowns require site-specific remediation or private/parked disposition where launch is gated; no fleet-wide legal clearance is supported.
